parameters.errorMessage: The review email was not sent. See the sanitized audit event for the result code.

parameters.content:
## One-shot controlled recovery

- Authorized only for FSV-LOCAL-TEST-001.
- Local POST only; original expiry anchor makes the mutation single-use.
- Updates only token_hash and expires_at on the existing pending row.
- Sensitive parent execution data is not saved.
- Gmail retry is disabled; ambiguous delivery requires mailbox inspection.
- No Google publishing node is present.
